Container.Name: Nuvio2Fusion
Container.Overview: Convert Nuvio collections into Fusion widget JSON. Keep folders, covers and connected addon sources; skip optional addons with warnings. No account login, database, appdata mapping or media mounts required. For trusted networks only: the app has no authentication and exported addon URLs may contain private tokens.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Open http://your-unraid-ip:7088. Change only the host port if it is already used. Keep access on your trusted network.
